description: A WorkSpec catalog artifact: the simple engine pricing model (pricing modes, schedules, SKUs).

asOf.description: Date the prices were captured, ISO 8601 (e.g. "2026-07-01"). Kept as a string so YAML does not coerce it to a date.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for all prices, e.g. "NZD".

spec.description: The priced tables the engine reads.

pricingModes.description: Available pricing modes referenced by SKU lines.

items.description: A pricing mode: a named multiplier on a SKU's PAYG list price.

committed.description: If true the mode bills 24×7 and ignores schedule (reserved/committed capacity); only non-committed modes benefit from scheduling a line off.

id.description: Stable id referenced by a SKU line's `mode`, e.g. "payg", "ri3".

mult.description: Multiplier applied to the SKU PAYG monthly list price. 1.0 = PAYG list; 0.5 = half price.

note.description: Optional freeform note explaining the mode.

short.description: Optional short badge label, e.g. "3Y RI".

schedules.description: Available schedule presets referenced by SKU lines.

items.description: A schedule preset: the share of the month a line actually runs.

id.description: Stable id referenced by a SKU line's `schedule`, e.g. "always", "business".

note.description: Optional freeform note explaining the schedule.

pct.description: Share of the ~730-hour month the line actually runs, 0..1. 1 = 24×7; 0.30 ≈ business hours.

skus.description: Priced catalogue items referenced by SKU lines.

items.description: A SKU: a priced catalogue item, quoted as a monthly PAYG list price.

family.description: Grouping family for display, e.g. "General compute".

id.description: Stable id referenced by a SKU line's `sku`, e.g. "d4s_v5".

price.description: Monthly PAYG list price for a single unit, in the catalog currency.

unit.description: Optional unit label for the price, e.g. "instance / month".

title: WorkSpec Catalog (v1alpha1)
